attribution.note: Marcus quotes his own February 2022 tweet in the post and offers it as a view he holds, so it is his own claim.

semantics.note: The normalised proposition keeps 'current', 'vision alone', 'reliable' and L5. It is a firm present-tense observation about capability.

contract.note: The plain reading is fair: a capability shortfall, as distinct from mere non-deployment. Using February 2022 as the period matches the tweet date. 'Cognitive depth' cannot be measured directly, so the claim has to be judged on driving performance.

evidence.note: The NHTSA notice opening a phantom-braking investigation (Feb 2022) records complaints, not findings. It concerns a Level 2 driver-assist system and does not attribute the braking to limits of vision-only neural nets, so it cannot settle the L5 question.

reviews.rationale: The only item is an NHTSA notice opening an investigation into complaints, with no causal finding. No contemporaneous evaluation shows that vision-only neural systems could not reach reliable L5, and no item shows a system that did. The packet does not settle the claim either way.

attribution.note: Marcus wrote this sentence himself in his own post.

semantics.note: The proposition follows his wording: the 2012 concerns still stand and he has not moved the goalposts. Context ties the concerns to the four limitations he named in 2012.

contract.note: The reading 'substantial unresolved limitations, not categorical inability' is fair and ordinary. Requiring both the four technical concerns and continuity of his criteria matches the compound sentence.

evidence.note: A May 2022 study found BERT's logical reasoning did not generalise across distributions. This supports only the logical-inference concern, not the whole claim.
The same paper shows BERT has the capacity to solve the task. That weakens a categorical reading but leaves the learning and generalisation concern standing.

reviews.rationale: The evidence partly supports one of four concerns, logical inference as a learned, robust skill. It says nothing on causal representation, abstract ideas, or integrating knowledge, and no record establishes that his criteria stayed the same. Nothing contradicts the claim, but the compound claim is not settled.

attribution.note: Marcus restates and endorses his own argument from his earlier post.

semantics.note: The proposition keeps 'systems like DALL-E', wheels and their function, 'systematically' and 'properly'. It is an observation joined to an inference.

contract.note: The reading 'repeatable failure, not occasional malformed images' is fair. Limiting the check to the systems he actually tested (Craiyon, Stable Diffusion) is appropriate.

evidence.note: A July 2022 study found DALL-E 2 failed most basic relation prompts. It used different prompts and a different system and did not test wheels or their function, so it is context only.

reviews.rationale: No independent test or replication of the September 2022 wheel and function prompts on the systems he referred to is in the packet. The relational-failure study is related but does not reach the contract's conditions. Nothing contradicts the claim.

attribution.note: Marcus wrote this sentence about his own record in his own post.

semantics.note: This is a claim about his own past record. The proposition keeps 'over and over' and 'vice versa'.

contract.note: Counting equivalent statements made on separate occasions is a fair, ordinary reading of 'over and over I have stressed'.

evidence.note: A 2015 Emerj interview report has him contrasting evolved human memory with better-engineered computer memory: something faithful to humans is not ideal design.
In a 2016 Edge conversation he separates engineers' accuracy goals from psychologists' explanations of human cognition.
On a February 2022 Mindscape podcast he says AI should take inspiration from biology without copying flaws such as confirmation bias.

reviews.rationale: Three separate, dated, independently hosted records from before the post (2015, 2016, 2022) show him separating good engineering from faithfully reproducing human cognition. That covers both directions of the distinction, and no counterevidence was found.
